changelog: Replaced all native JavaScript dialogs with an elegant in-game confirmation modal.
Completely overhauled customer shopping catalog with non-squished cards and multi-item shopping cart drawer.
Interactive 3D raycast prop inspector allowing admins to select any world props for removal upon store purchase.
Added Player Prop Spawner allowing store owners to purchase and place empty shelves inside designated boundaries.
Custom item-by-item supply delivery orders with boosted delivery truck capacities (150, 400, 1000 units).
